versions.text: Cylinder barrel temperatures shall be corrected by adding 0.7 of the difference between the maximum anticipated summer air temperature and the temperature is provided as specified in § 3.675. cal altitude or at the lowest prac of the ambient air at the first occurrence of the maximum cylinder barrel temperature recorded during the cooling test.
